monthly_review.summary: This month shows a sharp reduction in volume and intensity compared to last month, with notable pacing slowdown and elevated aerobic TE, suggesting fatigue or strategic tapering.
monthly_review.highlight: Cadence jumped +33 spm (151 vs 118) while average pace slowed and HR dropped — this reflects a shift toward very easy, low-effort jogging likely driven by fatigue or intentional recovery, not improved neuromuscular efficiency.

Chasing the number is inadvisable; sustainability and readiness must come first.

insights.title: Chronic sleep debt correlates with worsening running economy
insights.body: Despite HRV and resting HR improvements, sleep averaged only 4.8h (vs 4.5h baseline) and was under 7h on 15 of last 14 nights — coinciding with latest running economy worsening to 226.0 ml/kg/km (down from rolling median 253.9) and aerobic decoupling rising to 9.37% (above 5% threshold).

insights.title: Zone 3 dominance masks aerobic underdevelopment
insights.body: This month, 41% of time was spent in Zone 3 — up from 29% last month and 19% in May — while Zone 1+2 dropped to 45% (from 48% in July and 69% in May), suggesting a drift away from foundational aerobic work despite VO2max improving (+6.3% vs baseline).

insights.title: Cadence surge without pace/HR increase signals compensatory gait
insights.body: Cadence rose sharply to 151 spm (vs 118 in July) while avg pace slowed (+11 sec/km) and avg HR fell (-4 bpm); recent runs include multiple sub-2 km efforts at >15 min/km (e.g., 20:03 and 24:65 min/km on 2026-07-31), where cadence collapsed to 18–63 spm — indicating inconsistent neuromuscular control under fatigue.

insights.title: Recovery balance is strong but disconnected from subjective readiness
insights.body: Recovery balance is +3.14 (excellent), yet training readiness remains low (latest 38, 7-day avg 32.4) and body battery is only modestly improved (+6.1%); this mismatch suggests autonomic metrics are masking accumulated mental/cognitive fatigue or sleep architecture disruption.

recommendations.reason: Zone 2 volume rebuilds aerobic base without taxing recovery systems; cadence focus counters recent neuromuscular fragmentation seen in ultra-slow efforts
